404K likes, 2,537 comments - shawnmendes on July 9, 2026: "Honoured to launch two new signature guitars with @martinguitar, inspired by my favourite 1920s vintage Martin. These two models are both beautiful and so timeless, and I hope they help inspire other singer-songwriters like Martins have inspired me for years. 

And thank you to Martin for supporting @shawnfoundation through this partnership ♥️".
